meaning.en: To happen every single day; there is no day on which it does not occur.
meaning.zh: 没有一天不发生，形容经常、天天如此。

examples.zh: 这类网络诈骗几乎无日无之。
examples.en: Online scams of this kind happen almost every day.

examples.zh: 那几年边境冲突无日无之，百姓不得安宁。
examples.en: In those years border clashes occurred daily, and the people knew no peace.

examples.zh: 他对母亲的牵挂无日无之。
examples.en: Not a day passes without his thinking of his mother.

usage.en: Used as predicate; mostly written, formal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多用于书面语。

natural: a tired bird knows to go home

meaning.en: To long for home and return after being worn out by wandering or by official life.
meaning.zh: 鸟儿飞累了知道回巢，比喻在外奔波或做官疲倦后想要回家、归隐。

equivalents: home is the sailor, home from sea

examples.zh: 在外漂泊十年，他终于倦鸟知还，回到了故乡。
examples.en: After ten years adrift, he finally came home like a weary bird.

examples.zh: 官场浮沉多年，倦鸟知还，他决定辞职归隐。
examples.en: Tired of years in officialdom, he resolved to resign and retire to the countryside.

examples.zh: 倦鸟知还，春节时车站里挤满了回家的人。
examples.en: Like weary birds heading home, the station was packed with people returning for the New Year.

story.en: Tao Yuanming wrote, 'Clouds drift aimlessly out of the peaks; birds, tired of flying, know to return' (云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还), describing his resignation and return to the fields.
story.zh: 陶渊明《归去来兮辞》：“云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还。”

usage.en: Predicate or clause; literary tone, often about homecoming or retirement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或分句，带文学色彩，常指归乡、归隐。

synonyms: 云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还

meaning.en: A grown man; used to appeal to a man's sense of responsibility and dignity.
meaning.zh: 指身材高大的成年男子，常用来强调男子应有的担当和气概。

examples.zh: 七尺男儿，怎能遇到一点困难就哭鼻子？
examples.en: A grown man should not cry at the first difficulty.

examples.zh: 他是七尺男儿，该撑起这个家了。
examples.en: He is a grown man now and must hold this family up.

examples.zh: 七尺男儿当志在四方。
examples.en: A real man's ambitions should reach far and wide.

usage.en: Subject or object; often used to urge responsibility. 尺 here is the old Chinese foot, much shorter than today's.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，常用来激励人担当。这里的“尺”是古尺，比今天短。

meaning.en: To make claims or promises with nothing to back them up.
meaning.zh: 只是嘴上说说，没有行动或证据。

examples.zh: 别空口说白话，拿出证据来！
examples.en: Don't just talk; show us the evidence!

examples.zh: 光空口说白话，是建不起大楼的。
examples.en: You can't build a skyscraper on words alone.

examples.zh: 他只会空口说白话，从没真正做成过一件事。
examples.en: He is all talk and has never actually finished anything.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，常用来批评。

natural: no breakfast or dinner to follow

meaning.en: To be so poor that one cannot afford regular meals.
meaning.zh: 连早饭、晚饭都接不上，形容生活极其贫困。

equivalents: not know where the next meal is coming from

examples.zh: 那年灾荒，许多人家饔飧不继。
examples.en: In that famine year, many families could not count on their next meal.

examples.zh: 他早年饔飧不继，靠亲戚接济度日。
examples.en: In his youth he often went hungry and lived on relatives' help.

examples.zh: 小说里的老人晚年饔飧不继，令人心酸。
examples.en: The old man in the novel, without regular meals in his last years, is heartbreaking.

usage.en: Predicate; literary, written. 饔 is breakfast, 飧 is supper.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。饔指早饭，飧指晚饭。

natural: Lian Po is not old yet

meaning.en: Said of an older person who is still vigorous and capable.
meaning.zh: 指年纪大了仍然精力充沛，能够胜任工作。

examples.zh: 六十岁的老教练廉颇未老，球队在他手下连赢五场。
examples.en: The 60-year-old coach is still going strong, winning five games in a row.

examples.zh: 爷爷干起农活来廉颇未老，一点不输年轻人。
examples.en: Grandpa works the fields as well as any young man.

examples.zh: 他退休后重回岗位，廉颇未老。
examples.en: Back at work after retirement, he showed he had lost none of his edge.

usage.en: Predicate or clause. A positive reversal of 廉颇老矣; the allusion is to the Warring States general Lian Po, who ate heartily to prove he was still fit for command.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或分句。与“廉颇老矣”相对，用战国名将廉颇以饭量证明自己尚可用的典故。

pinyin: tiě dǎ de yíng pán liú shuǐ de bīng
literal: iron · forged · 's · camp · flowing water · 's · soldiers
natural: an iron-built camp and soldiers like flowing water

meaning.en: The institution stays while its people keep changing.
meaning.zh: 营盘像铁打的一样固定不变，士兵却像流水一样不断更替，比喻单位长存而人员常换。

equivalents: the institution endures while people come and go
the fortress stays, the garrison changes

examples.zh: 铁打的营盘流水的兵，这家公司每年都要换一批人。
examples.en: The company stays and the staff turn over; every year a new batch comes.

examples.zh: 铁打的营盘流水的兵，老师傅走了，规矩还在。
examples.en: The camp is iron and the soldiers are water: the old masters leave, but the rules remain.

examples.zh: 班主任说：铁打的营盘流水的兵，学长毕业了，传统要传下去。
examples.en: The teacher said that the school remains while students move on, so the tradition must be handed down.

usage.en: Clause or full saying; often used of workplaces, schools and the army, sometimes with a sigh about high turnover.
usage.zh: 可作分句或整句，常用于单位、学校、部队，有时带有对人员流动频繁的感叹。

meaning.en: To get smooth, unobstructed passage or approval at every step.
meaning.zh: 一路上都是绿灯，比喻办事没有阻碍、顺利通过。

equivalents: get the green light all the way

examples.zh: 这个项目有领导支持，审批一路绿灯。
examples.en: With the leadership's backing, the project sailed through every approval.

examples.zh: 新能源车企在手续上一路绿灯。
examples.en: The electric-car maker gets smooth approval at every step of the paperwork.

examples.zh: 今天上班路上一路绿灯，我提前十分钟到了公司。
examples.en: I hit green lights all the way to work and arrived ten minutes early.

usage.en: Predicate, often with 开 or 放: 开绿灯 means to grant approval. Can imply special treatment.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“开绿灯”“放绿灯”，有时暗含特殊照顾。

meaning.en: Saying nothing is often wiser than speaking.
meaning.zh: 在许多场合保持沉默比说话更明智。

examples.zh: 会议上他没有争辩，觉得沉默是金。
examples.en: He didn't argue in the meeting, feeling that silence is golden.

examples.zh: 遇到不懂的事，沉默是金，别乱发表意见。
examples.en: When you don't understand something, keep quiet instead of giving opinions.

examples.zh: 沉默是金，但该开口时也不能退缩。
examples.en: Silence is golden, but you can't hold back when it is time to speak up.

usage.en: Usually a standalone saying. Adapted from the English proverb (Carlyle's 'Speech is silver, silence is golden'). It is often countered by 会哭的孩子有奶吃.
usage.zh: 多单独成句。源自西方谚语（卡莱尔“说话是银，沉默是金”）。常与“会哭的孩子有奶吃”对照。

meaning.en: Honest, unassertive people tend to end up losing out.
meaning.zh: 为人老实、不争不抢的人往往会吃亏。

equivalents: the honest man gets the short end of the stick

examples.zh: 别总是让着别人，老实人吃亏啊。
examples.en: Don't always give way; the honest one ends up losing.

examples.zh: 老实人吃亏，这话在职场上有时是真的。
examples.en: 'Honest folk lose out' is sometimes true in the workplace.

examples.zh: 他从不抢功，结果老实人吃亏，奖金被别人拿走了。
examples.en: He never took credit, so, as they say, the honest man lost out, and others took his bonus.

usage.en: Often said as a complaint or a warning; the full 老实人吃亏，无赖占便宜 is also heard. Opposite sentiments: 老实人有福 (honesty pays off).
usage.zh: 多用于抱怨或提醒。常见全句“老实人吃亏，无赖占便宜”。

natural: as radiant as peach and plum blossom

meaning.en: To be dazzlingly beautiful, like peach and plum blossoms in bloom.
meaning.zh: 像桃花李花一样艳丽，多形容女子容貌美丽。

examples.zh: 那位女演员艳若桃李，引得满场注目。
examples.en: The actress, radiant as spring blossom, drew every eye in the hall.

examples.zh: 春天的公园里，花朵艳若桃李。
examples.en: In the spring park, the flowers are bright as peach and plum blossom.

examples.zh: 她年轻时艳若桃李，如今依然优雅。
examples.en: She was dazzling in her youth and is still graceful now.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; mostly of women, literary. Often paired with 冷若冰霜 (艳若桃李，冷若冰霜: beautiful but cold).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多形容女子，书面语。常与“冷若冰霜”连用。

natural: fields linked across all the paths

meaning.en: To own vast stretches of farmland, so that one's fields run from path to path.
meaning.zh: 田地一块连着一块，铺满了田间小路，形容占有的土地极多。

equivalents: own land as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 那位地主田连阡陌，雇了上百名佃农。
examples.en: The landlord owned fields as far as the eye could see and employed hundreds of tenants.

examples.zh: 史书记载，当时富豪田连阡陌，农民却无立锥之地。
examples.en: Chronicles record that the rich owned endless fields while peasants had nowhere to stand.

examples.zh: 他家祖上曾田连阡陌，如今只剩一座老宅。
examples.en: His ancestors once owned vast farmland; now only an old house remains.

usage.en: Predicate; written. Usually points to land concentration in the hands of the rich.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，常指土地集中在富人手中。

story.en: Dong Zhongshu, in the Han Shu Treatise on Food and Goods, said the rich own fields running from path to path while the poor have no room for an awl. 田连阡陌 comes from this.
story.zh: 《汉书·食货志上》载董仲舒言：“富者田连阡陌，贫者无立锥之地。”

literal: look down · look up · no · shame
natural: no shame whether looking up or down

meaning.en: To have a clear conscience before heaven and other people.
meaning.zh: 抬头低头都问心无愧，形容为人正直、坦荡。

examples.zh: 我做事俯仰无愧，不怕别人调查。
examples.en: I have acted with a clear conscience and fear no investigation.

examples.zh: 他一生清白，俯仰无愧。
examples.en: He lived an honest life with nothing to be ashamed of.

examples.zh: 只要俯仰无愧，何必在意流言？
examples.en: As long as your conscience is clear, why care about gossip?

usage.en: Predicate; often with 于天地. Based on Mencius's 仰不愧于天，俯不怍于人.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“俯仰无愧于天地”。化用孟子“仰不愧于天，俯不怍于人”。

meaning.en: To feel deeply ashamed of one's conduct before heaven and everyone.
meaning.zh: 对上愧对苍天，对下愧对众人，形容极其惭愧。

examples.zh: 他辜负了朋友的信任，愧天怍人。
examples.en: He betrayed his friend's trust and was thoroughly ashamed.

examples.zh: 贪污事发后，他愧天怍人，主动自首。
examples.en: When his embezzlement came out, he felt deep shame and turned himself in.

examples.zh: 做了这样的错事，真让我愧天怍人。
examples.en: Having done such a wrong thing, I feel ashamed before everyone.

usage.en: Predicate; written. The reverse of 不愧不怍 and 俯仰无愧.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，与“不愧不怍”相反。

meaning.en: To fail to carry out an assigned task in a way worthy of the trust placed in one.
meaning.zh: 辜负了所受的委托，没有完成好交给的任务。

examples.zh: 我们一定努力工作，决不有辱使命。
examples.en: We will work hard and never fail the task entrusted to us.

examples.zh: 他在谈判中一再让步，有辱使命。
examples.en: He kept making concessions at the talks and failed in his mission.

examples.zh: 万一有辱使命，我愿负全部责任。
examples.en: If I fail in my mission I will bear full responsibility.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, often seen in its negated form 不辱使命.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，常用否定式“不辱使命”。

natural: make a name and honour one's parents

meaning.en: To win fame and bring honour to one's parents.
meaning.zh: 使自己名声远扬，也使父母显赫荣耀。

examples.zh: 他苦读多年，只盼金榜题名，扬名显亲。
examples.en: He studied for years, hoping to pass the exams and bring honour to his parents.

examples.zh: 古人读书求仕，志在扬名显亲。
examples.en: Scholars of old pursued office to make a name and honour their parents.

examples.zh: 他以优异成绩考入名校，也算扬名显亲了。
examples.en: Entering a top school with outstanding results, he made his parents proud.

usage.en: Predicate or purpose clause; literary. Based on the Classic of Filial Piety, which counts making one's name known as the end of filial duty.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或目的分句，书面语。化用《孝经》“扬名于后世，以显父母，孝之终也”。

natural: a fly clinging to a swift horse's tail

meaning.en: To rise to fame or success by attaching oneself to someone great; also a humble way of describing oneself as a follower.
meaning.zh: 苍蝇附在千里马尾巴上可以远行，比喻依附名人而成名；也常作自谦之词。

examples.zh: 我不过是蝇附骥尾，成绩全靠导师指点。
examples.en: I am merely a fly on a fine horse's tail; my results all come from my advisor's guidance.

examples.zh: 这篇论文能发表，实有蝇附骥尾之幸。
examples.en: It is my good fortune to be riding on a great scholar's coattails that the paper was published.

examples.zh: 他靠着大人物的关系蝇附骥尾，才有了今天。
examples.en: He got where he is by clinging to a powerful person.

story.en: Sima Qian wrote that even the diligent Yan Hui 'became more famous by attaching to the tail of a swift horse' (颜渊虽笃学，附骥尾而行益显), i.e. by following Confucius; later commentators turned this into the image of a fly on the tail.
story.zh: 《史记·伯夷列传》：“颜渊虽笃学，附骥尾而行益显。”后人引申为“蝇附骥尾”。

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral, self-deprecating (humble) or mildly critical of someone else. The headword form is later; the Shiji has 附骥尾.
usage.zh: 可作谓语。用于自谦时为谦辞，用于他人则略带贬义。四字形式较晚，《史记》作“附骥尾”。
